newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers higher on refinery trouble.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers higher on refinery trouble.

text.p: North American bunker prices were higher on Tuesday due to a tightness in barrels, cold weather and refinery troubles in Texas, players said.
Snowfall has been reported in parts of the U.S. Midwest and Northeast since the weekend, driving up demand for bunkers and heating fuels.
In the East Coast, New York Harbor spot 380 CST surged $13 to between $130 and $132 a tonne. 180 CST rose $11 to $134/135.
Trade was steady but a tightness in supply caused price spikes since last Thursday.
